status: Active five-role coding; contextual review of 119 previously unmatched accounts completed 16 October 2026. Other eleven fields unchanged.
supersedes_for_future_work: Replaces v3.0 role assignments for context-resolved accounts. File history is managed through Git; no parallel coding corpus.

basis.framework: SIPC fields retained from existing coding; the five role categories are researcher-specified, not categories prescribed by SIPC.

future_role_revision.categories: Five researcher-specified imaginaries informed by the researcher’s 100-article reading.
future_role_revision.method: Semantic review of inherited account statements; open extraction and targeted source context used to resolve role links. No keyword classifier or old-code crosswalk.
future_role_revision.scope: Only future_role and its direct evidence/details revised. Desirability and the other ten fields are unchanged. No independent human intercoder reliability claim.

unit: Source-attributed educational future account, with distinct propositions, evaluation targets and interventions kept traceable within the account.
missing_policy: MISSING is a non-substantive exclusive field value for absent or insufficient specification. An explicitly supplied horizon without distance wording is TIME_ANCHORED_UNCLASSIFIED; unspecified AI form is OBJ_UNSPECIFIED. These fallbacks preserve partial information rather than inventing it. Inadequate sources remain unresolved_source.
eligibility_rules: Require a projected, desired, prescribed, opposed or explicitly being-realised educational arrangement involving AI. A present implementation qualifies only when its intended educational direction is articulated.
AI mentions, usage statistics, benchmarks, product announcements and completed misconduct incidents do not alone qualify.
Do not impose Vietnamese geographic scope or national-development motives on foreign examples or generic claims.
application_rules: Use inherited open extraction and attributed account statements first; consult retained source context where the role link is unclear.

Code source-articulated sought, expected and feared educational roles/outcomes. Preserve literal AI function, direction and conditions. Do not replace warnings with benevolent goals or infer an actor’s intention from an unwanted forecast.

For every code, retain a proposition/target/intervention identifier, an exact source anchor and a short decision reason. A shared source sentence can support several fields when it independently answers their different questions.
Within a field, additional codes require separate supported propositions, objects, reasons, actors or interventions; synonymous descriptions of one item do not justify multiple coding.
Exactly one desirability value per evaluation target. Split distinct target evaluations; do not combine opposing voices into mixed.

Preserve source-stated mechanisms, direction, educational ends, conditions, claim mode, affiliations, product names, activities, locations and timings as literal details. These are supporting attributes, not extra SIPC dimensions or category inventories.
Do not infer a second category from scale, implementation mechanism, affiliation or an expected downstream benefit.
If a claim does not fit without stretching a definition, retain it as an unresolved boundary case with evidence; do not force or silently add a code.

An identifiable projected or normative educational arrangement remains eligible when its end is insufficiently specified: future_role=MISSING, literal function retained. Privacy/legal/data-exposure consequences do not become achievement or care unless that end is explicit; log uncovered outcomes without inventing categories.

Code the focal causal warrant: staffing requirements as operational capacity; employment demand, wages or economic returns as economy. Do not assign both from one staffing threshold unless separate warrants are articulated.
Responsibility requires an actor explicitly assigned an intervention, including an unambiguous grammatical subject. Do not infer an implementer from an actorless prescription or national aspiration.

Speaking capacity follows the attributed role in the passage. Affiliation alone does not establish expertise, leadership or public authority. Explicit commitments/plans are intentions rather than confident predictions unless occurrence is independently asserted.

Desirability mixed requires explicit benefits and harms of the same arrangement from the same voice, even if benefits are said to outweigh harms. An explicitly unanswered value question can be undecided; rhetorical criticism alone cannot. Value uncertainty is not occurrence uncertainty.

Timespan describes projected timing. A planned implementation start/interval can be anchored-unclassified; course duration alone is not a future horizon. Do not correct inconsistent source chronology or impose numeric near/distant thresholds.

Education context follows explicitly established delivery setting, not destination or host institution. A university entrance examination without a specified school/higher delivery sector has context MISSING, retaining admissions activity literally.
Object family requires source-supported technical form/function. A familiar brand name alone does not license external technical inference; retain brand and use unspecified when form is absent.

ACT_RULES requires institutional/system permissions, safeguards or enforceable requirements. Individual pedagogic checking/judgment without such a rule is ACT_PRACTICE. ACT_EVALUATE concerns evaluating the AI intervention, not grading a student.

Country/scope can be inherited from an explicitly shared source-described programme/institution context, with supporting quote. Do not infer country from external locality knowledge, byline, publication domain or actor nationality; record literal locality and missing scope if necessary.

Educational inclusion requires an explicit educational participation/opportunity end. Broader digital/social inclusion alone does not establish it. A stated goal does not automatically constitute its own rationale.

Surveillance belongs to educational management when an operational monitoring/safety purpose is explicit; preserve coercion, error, privacy and criticism literally. Governance of AI alone is not an AI management-tool role.

Interpret future_role from the future being evaluated, not from whether the account endorses it. Use inherited open extraction and attributed account statements first. A warning, safeguard, implementation condition or evaluation may receive the role of its clearly identified target in the same source. Require a demonstrable shared referent (the same programme, tool, arrangement or continuing attributed argument). Record the contextual link and exact source anchors in the account. Do not transfer another speaker’s evaluation, certainty or intention, or assign all roles in the article. Generic policy, risk or market claims without an identifiable role remain MISSING. The five role definitions and all eleven other fields remain unchanged; desirability already records positive, negative, mixed and undecided evaluation. No sixth role or separate positive/negative role subcodes are used.

account_requirements.existing: Keep speaker_reference, future_statement, evaluation_target, stance, qualification, role_details and evidence_reference.
account_requirements.new_evidence_requirement: For recoding, field_evidence links each assigned code to its proposition, target/object/action, source span and decision reason. Proposition IDs are account-local. They are traceability attributes, not new analytical fields.
account_requirements.role_details: Retain AI’s literal role/function, the sought/expected/feared end or outcome, mechanism, direction, conditions and source evidence. Code field values from explicit propositions, not disconnected mentions. For context-resolved accounts, explain the shared target linking the condition/warning to the role.
account_requirements.certainty_details: Record claim_mode (prediction/intention/prescription/question, in source terms), condition and the proposition to which epistemic certainty applies. Neither mode nor condition is a certainty code.
account_requirements.literal_space_details: Retain exact country, locality/institution and scope wording. A foreign domestic code must name the actual country; Vietnam codes must retain whether reach is institutional, local, subnational or national.

field_questions.future_role: Which of the five projected educational relationships or purposes does this account articulate?
field_questions.certainty: How firmly does the speaker claim that the specified future will or can occur?
field_questions.desirability: How does this speaker evaluate this particular future arrangement?
field_questions.rationale: What explicit reason, need or value explains why this goal or arrangement is desirable or undesirable?
field_questions.technology_object: What technical form of AI is explicitly implicated in the future?
field_questions.education_context: In what educational sector or setting is the future located?
field_questions.timespan: How does the source characterise the proximity or continuity of the educational future, and what exact horizon does it supply?
field_questions.space: Which country or cross-border arena is explicitly the intended reach of the educational future?
field_questions.speaker: In what stated capacity does this actor articulate the future?
field_questions.affected_entities: Who or what is explicitly expected to experience the consequences?
field_questions.action: What concrete intervention or restraint is proposed to pursue or prevent the future?
field_questions.responsibility: Which actor is explicitly assigned the proposed intervention or accountability?

field_rules.future_role: Interpret future_role from the future being evaluated, not from whether the account endorses it. Use inherited open extraction and attributed account statements first. A warning, safeguard, implementation condition or evaluation may receive the role of its clearly identified target in the same source. Require a demonstrable shared referent (the same programme, tool, arrangement or continuing attributed argument). Record the contextual link and exact source anchors in the account. Do not transfer another speaker’s evaluation, certainty or intention, or assign all roles in the article. Generic policy, risk or market claims without an identifiable role remain MISSING. The five role definitions and all eleven other fields remain unchanged; desirability already records positive, negative, mixed and undecided evaluation. No sixth role or separate positive/negative role subcodes are used. Existing literal_details retain earlier descriptive notes; current codes.future_role and missing_notes.future_role govern classification.
field_rules.certainty: One code per proposition. Intention, prescription, endorsement and contingency are not certainty categories. Retain them as literal qualifiers (claim_mode, condition). A planned or required future without an epistemic claim receives MISSING. Different predictions within an account can have different codes only with separate proposition anchors.
field_rules.desirability: Exactly one code or MISSING per evaluation target. Mixed requires a same-speaker, same-arrangement weighing of benefits and harms, not merely different conditions of use or opposing voices. For example, the same AI-supported work/learning arrangement can increase productivity while weakening skill accumulation. Split explicitly different desired and feared alternatives; do not pool them into mixed. A ban or safeguard can be positively valued. Predictions do not imply approval.
field_rules.rationale: Code an explicit warrant for the goal/evaluation, not the goal repeated as its own explanation. A stated causal reason, need or principle can supply a rationale. Preparing graduates for work is a goal; a shortage of AI specialists is a rationale. National autonomy is a goal; dependence on foreign technology can justify it. The same desired outcome alone does not automatically receive both role and rationale codes. Distinct warrants can coexist with separate source anchors.
field_rules.technology_object: Classify model/system family, not educational function, interface, product reputation or institutional scale. Retain product names, methods, robots/virtual interfaces, computing infrastructure, deployment architecture and educational use as literal details. AI as a subject of study belongs to future_role, not an extra technical-form category. Unknown form receives OBJ_UNSPECIFIED; this fallback cannot accompany a specified form for the same object. Independent objects can receive different codes.
field_rules.education_context: Use setting rather than repeating learning, teaching, assessment or management functions already captured elsewhere. Record educational activity, subject, formal level and delivery mode as literal details. Institution size, beneficiaries and online delivery do not determine sector. Multiple sectors require explicit reach across them; otherwise use MISSING.
field_rules.timespan: Immediate means explicitly being realised at the source reference time. Near-term and distant use the source’s own near/soon/short-term or distant/long-term wording. Ongoing requires explicit continuous/lifelong updating rather than a completion point. No five-year or other analyst-imposed numerical threshold is used. If the source supplies only a date, quantified interval or implementation stage, retain it and use TIME_ANCHORED_UNCLASSIFIED rather than infer near/distant. Bare future tense with no temporal specification is MISSING. A present launch is coded only when linked to an articulated intended educational arrangement. Different explicitly stated phases can have separate source anchors.
field_rules.space: Classify geographic orientation and record exact places separately: country, province/city, institution/network and explicit scale (site, subnational, national or cross-border). Vietnam means an explicit Vietnamese reach, not Vietnamese publication or a Vietnamese speaker. A foreign domestic future must name its actual country; an institution-bound US initiative is foreign domestic with institutional scale. An international source/framework does not make a domestic future cross-border. Global requires explicit worldwide reach. A location appearing only as background or an example does not locate the focal future. Multiple domestic examples are not automatically one transnational future. Use MISSING if geographic reach cannot be supported.
field_rules.speaker: Use the speaking capacity established in the source, not the content or sophistication of the claim. One capacity per attributed voice by default. A professor speaking for a university is leadership; speaking as a practitioner/researcher is academic professional. A signed expert essay is an academic/expert voice when identified as such, not automatically authorial narration. Collective joint attribution or explicit dual capacity requires separate evidence. Retain names, affiliations, titles and quoted/narrated status.
field_rules.affected_entities: Separate individuals, organisations and wider collectivities. An institutional affiliation is not an affected organisation unless the organisation itself is at stake. Code multiple explicitly affected entity types, not every actor mentioned. Beneficiaries need not be speakers or responsible actors.
field_rules.action: Code the operative intervention, not its future benefit. One code per intervention clause; independent interventions can coexist. Preserve whether it enables, restricts, prohibits, continues or postpones use. A broad should adapt without an identifiable intervention receives MISSING. Buying a tool and using it in teaching are distinct only if both are explicitly proposed.
field_rules.responsibility: Link an explicitly assigned or proposed action to its named actor. Do not infer duty from affiliation, authority, expertise or being affected. A source explicitly proposing that parents use learning materials is an assigned action; mentioning that parents benefit is not. Preserve whether the action is required, recommended, committed, conditionally assigned or offered as an actor’s option. AI-only action does not establish human/organisational responsibility.

future_role.label: AI as a Learning Partner
future_role.central_future_statement: AI will transform learning into a more personalized and collaborative process.
future_role.definition: AI changes the learning process, learner development, and relationships among learners, teachers and AI.
future_role.inclusion: Tutoring, personalization, collaborative learning, teacher instructional support, and development or erosion of understanding, creativity, autonomy and practical learning. Includes explicit loss of learning-by-doing through AI automation.
future_role.exclusion: Formal assessment/recognition alone; institutional administration; learning about AI alone; job displacement without an articulated learning consequence.
future_role.boundary_rule: Lesson preparation and learning feedback belong here; assessment validity, grades, integrity and recognized competence belong to educational judgment. A feared loss of thinking can belong here without endorsing AI as a good partner.

evidence_examples.source_excerpt: Một hướng tiếp cận được nhiều diễn giả nhắc đến là AI nên đóng vai trò hỗ trợ tư duy, thay vì giải bài thay học sinh. Ông Dominic Liechti, Giám đốc cấp cao marketing sản phẩm giáo dục toàn cầu của Apple, cho rằng học sinh vẫn cần tự viết bản nháp đầu tiên, sau đó mới dùng AI để phản biện lập luận hay góc nhìn của chính mình.

future_role.label: AI as a Force Reshaping Educational Judgment
future_role.central_future_statement: AI will change how educational achievement, integrity, and competence are assessed and recognized.
future_role.definition: AI changes assessment, academic integrity, authenticity, and recognition of educational achievement or competence.
future_role.inclusion: Grading, examination and assessment redesign, cheating/authorship, credential recognition and the validity or fairness of educational judgments.
future_role.exclusion: Routine administration, behaviour monitoring without competence/achievement judgment, and formative learning help without assessment/recognition stakes.
future_role.boundary_rule: Generating or evaluating assessed work is different from supporting learning. An AI-subject competition alone is not a change in educational judgment.

evidence_examples.source_excerpt: Đề thi cần chuyển hướng sang đánh giá năng lực lập luận cá nhân, tư duy phản biện trước các tình huống đa chiều, và đặc biệt là đánh giá quá trình tạo ra sản phẩm thay vì chỉ nhìn vào văn bản cuối cùng. Những buổi phản biện trực tiếp, những dự án nghiên cứu gắn liền với đời sống thực tế sẽ buộc học sinh phải thật sự bước vào hành trình tư duy.

future_role.label: AI as an Educational Management Tool
future_role.central_future_statement: AI will make educational institutions more efficient, data-driven, and responsive.
future_role.definition: AI changes educational operations, administration, institutional services, monitoring and resource allocation.
future_role.inclusion: Administrative workload, attendance, institutional data use, admissions information services, resource planning and school safety/monitoring. Include dysfunctions or contested control within these arrangements.
future_role.exclusion: Learner competence assessment; pedagogical preparation alone; policies governing AI adoption without a specified AI-enabled operational function.
future_role.boundary_rule: Distinguish AI used for educational management from management of AI implementation. A school or ministry as actor does not by itself establish this role.

future_role.label: AI Literacy as an Educational Imperative
future_role.central_future_statement: Education must prepare people to live, learn, and work responsibly in an AI-driven world.
future_role.definition: Education prepares people to understand, develop, critically use and live or work with AI.
future_role.inclusion: AI knowledge and curricula; ethical/critical AI use; educator AI competence; specialist AI formation and professional preparation explicitly oriented to an AI-driven world.
future_role.exclusion: Using AI merely to improve an existing learning process; automation/job loss without an educational preparation response; collective development inferred only from an institution or country name.
future_role.boundary_rule: The object of formation is people’s AI-related understanding/capacity. Individual AI study can fit; a national-development motive is not assumed. If training is only the mechanism of a stated collective goal, do not automatically add this code.

evidence_examples.source_excerpt: Mình muốn tiếp tục theo đuổi ước mơ được nghiên cứu về trí tuệ nhân tạo và cả thực tại ảo nữa.

future_role.label: AI as a Driver of National Development
future_role.central_future_statement: AI education will strengthen the workforce, technological capabilities, and national development.
future_role.definition: AI-related education or university research serves an explicitly articulated collective, sectoral or national development purpose.
future_role.inclusion: Collective workforce formation, sectoral technological capacity, national innovation/competitiveness, technological sovereignty, and explicit wider societal development. Retain the actual country/sector and any feared consequence.
future_role.exclusion: Individual employability or study aspirations alone; institutional prestige/ranking alone; national location, state affiliation, policy name, or cultural subject matter without an articulated collective development purpose.
future_role.boundary_rule: Require the collective/sectoral/national end in the account and source. Workforce demand may justify a sectoral workforce goal; it does not turn every individual career aspiration into national development.

evidence_examples.source_excerpt: Bộ GD-ĐT cho rằng việc đưa trí tuệ nhân tạo thành một trong những môn thi học sinh giỏi quốc gia sẽ góp phần phát hiện, bồi dưỡng nguồn nhân lực có năng lực về AI, đáp ứng yêu cầu phát triển khoa học, công nghệ và nguồn nhân lực chất lượng cao của đất nước.

certainty.label: Confident prediction
certainty.definition: The speaker presents the future outcome as a firm expectation.
certainty.inclusion: An explicit assertion of expected occurrence or assured capability.
certainty.exclusion: A plan, policy requirement or aspiration by itself; present achievement.
certainty.boundary_rule: Interpret the utterance in context: will implement can be a commitment, whereas will replace teachers is a prediction. A condition does not automatically make a prediction tentative.

certainty.label: Possible outcome
certainty.definition: The speaker presents an outcome or capability as possible, probable or potential without assuring its occurrence.
certainty.inclusion: May, might, could or a semantically equivalent qualified forecast.
certainty.exclusion: A commitment alone; explicit non-occurrence; unspecified future timing.
certainty.boundary_rule: Conditionality is recorded separately. Could happen if X remains possible; will happen if X can be confident conditional prediction.

evidence_examples.source_title: Sinh viên đua nhau 'nhờ vả' AI: Tiện ích hay mối nguy trong học tập?
evidence_examples.source_excerpt: Đồng thời, việc sử dụng AI "vô tội vạ" có thể làm giảm khả năng sáng tạo của sinh viên: "Khi quá phụ thuộc vào AI, sinh viên có thể trở nên lười suy nghĩ và không phát triển được các ý tưởng sáng tạo của riêng mình. AI có thể cung cấp đáp án nhanh chóng, nhưng không thể thay thế khả năng tư duy độc lập và sáng tạo của con người", anh giải thích.

certainty.label: Denied outcome or capability
certainty.definition: The speaker explicitly rules out a specified future outcome or capability.
certainty.inclusion: Cannot, will not or an explicit rejection of a particular predicted capability.
certainty.exclusion: A proposal to ban something; a warning about harms; limited performance that does not rule out a future.
certainty.boundary_rule: AI cannot replace human empathy denies a capability; schools should not replace teachers prescribes restraint and is not necessarily denial. Preserve exactly what is denied.

certainty.label: Explicitly unresolved outcome
certainty.definition: The speaker explicitly withholds a prediction or states that an outcome cannot yet be determined.
certainty.inclusion: An open question about whether an outcome will occur or a statement that evidence is insufficient to predict it.
certainty.exclusion: Missing certainty language; merely presenting several possible consequences; value judgment left open rather than occurrence.
certainty.boundary_rule: Will it work? concerns certainty. Is it educationally desirable? concerns DES_UNDECIDED. Code both only if both questions are explicit.

desirability.label: Desirable
desirability.definition: The speaker positively values the specified future.
desirability.inclusion: Explicit benefits, endorsement or a preferred educational arrangement.
desirability.exclusion: Coder approval; a bare plan; positive sentiment about AI unrelated to the future.
desirability.boundary_rule: Support for safeguards can be positive even when AI misuse is condemned as a different target.

evidence_examples.source_title: Khung năng lực trí tuệ nhân tạo cho học sinh: Hiểu và làm chủ công nghệ

desirability.label: Undesirable
desirability.definition: The speaker negatively values the specified future.
desirability.inclusion: Explicit harm, opposition or an unwanted educational arrangement.
desirability.exclusion: Mere uncertainty, restriction or non-use without a negative evaluation of that target.
desirability.boundary_rule: Record the unwanted arrangement precisely, such as teacher displacement, rather than labelling AI in general negative.

desirability.label: Explicitly mixed
desirability.definition: One speaker explicitly weighs desirable and undesirable effects of the same future arrangement.
desirability.exclusion: Rival voices; a desired safeguard and a separately condemned harm; conditions alone.
desirability.boundary_rule: Conditional approval remains positive if the condition protects a desired arrangement and no benefits/harms are weighed for that same target.

rationale.label: Learning quality

rationale.boundary_rule: What changes is future_role; why this change supports or harms learning is rationale. Do not duplicate a bare outcome as its own explanation.

evidence_examples.anchor_phrase: bỏ qua cơ hội rèn luyện khả năng tư duy

rationale.label: Operational feasibility and efficiency
rationale.definition: Educational provision is justified or constrained by staffing, time, infrastructure, cost or implementation capacity.
rationale.inclusion: Teacher workload, institutional budget, computing readiness or practicality.
rationale.exclusion: Supplier profits, graduate employability or national strategic standing.

evidence_examples.source_title: “AI Buddy - Trợ giảng số” miễn phí tiếp sức giúp giáo viên đổi mới
evidence_examples.source_excerpt: Giữa những trăn trở của giáo viên về áp lực thời gian và thiếu công cụ thực hành, "trợ giảng số" AI Buddy được kỳ vọng sẽ tiếp sức cho đội ngũ nhà giáo tự tin đổi mới, đồng thời hiện thực hóa mục tiêu chuẩn bị nguồn nhân lực cho kỷ nguyên kinh tế số.
evidence_examples.anchor_phrase: áp lực thời gian và thiếu công cụ

rationale.label: Employment and economic returns
rationale.definition: Expected employment, occupational demand, income or commercial returns warrant the future.
rationale.inclusion: AI workforce shortages, job preparedness, graduate earnings or explicit business incentives.
rationale.exclusion: General social change with no economic claim; institutional affordability alone; national autonomy.
rationale.boundary_rule: Workforce participation or profit is here. Explicit national competitive standing is RATION_NATIONAL; code both only when separate economic and strategic warrants are stated.

Tuy nhiên, hiện tại, số lượng nhân lực trong ngành này mới chỉ đáp ứng khoảng 10% so với nhu cầu, tương đương với 50.000 đến 60.000 người. Thực tế này cũng được phản ánh trong báo cáo của VietnamWorks, khi nhu cầu nhân lực trong lĩnh vực này đã tăng gấp 4 lần trong 10 năm qua và dự báo sẽ t

evidence_examples.source_title: Trí tuệ nhân tạo có thể làm giáo dục thêm khủng hoảng
evidence_examples.source_excerpt: Trí tuệ nhân tạo mang lại khả năng tự động hóa, điều này đặc biệt hấp dẫn đối với các tổ chức quan tâm đến tối đa hóa lợi nhuận và cân bằng ngân sách của họ. Nhiều nghiên cứu cho thấy tự động hóa liên quan đến xu hướng ủng hộ chủ doanh nghiệp hơn là người lao động.
evidence_examples.anchor_phrase: tối đa hóa lợi nhuận

rationale.label: Equality of opportunity
rationale.definition: Fair distribution of educational opportunity warrants the future.
rationale.inclusion: Exclusion, disadvantage, unequal access or a principle of equal educational opportunity.
rationale.exclusion: Fair grading, due process or content reliability alone.
rationale.boundary_rule: Fair access is here; fair judgment of achievement or protection of rights is RATION_RIGHTS_INTEGRITY.

evidence_examples.source_title: Góc nhìn giáo dục: 5 rủi ro cho giáo dục khi sử dụng AI
evidence_examples.source_excerpt: Rủi ro thứ tư là tính công bằng và bình đẳng trong tiếp cận. Không phải tất cả sinh viên đều có điều kiện tiếp cận các công cụ AI chất lượng cao, kết nối internet ổn định hoặc trình độ hiểu biết về AI như nhau. Ngoài ra, nhiều hệ thống AI hiện nay hoạt động hiệu quả hơn bằng tiếng Anh so với tiếng
evidence_examples.anchor_phrase: Không phải tất cả sinh viên

rationale.label: Rights, reliability and academic integrity
rationale.definition: Protecting rights, trustworthy information, authentic achievement or fair adjudication warrants the future.
rationale.inclusion: Privacy, accuracy, consent, authorship recognition, academic honesty or due process.
rationale.exclusion: Generic ethics without a specified principle; compassion alone; unequal access alone.
rationale.boundary_rule: Specific enforceable protections and academic validity are here. Broader human flourishing or democratic educational purpose is RATION_HUMAN_VALUES.

evidence_examples.source_title: Sinh viên viết hay bị nghi dùng AI: Ai có quyền phán xét?
evidence_examples.source_excerpt: ểm số, và cả niềm tin, bị quyết định bởi những dòng code chưa minh bạch, nền giáo dục sẽ không còn dựa trên hiểu biết, mà trên... xác suất. Và một khi thầy cô thôi hỏi "em nghĩ gì khi viết đoạn này?", mà chỉ nhìn vào phần trăm hiện lên trên màn hình, thì mối quan hệ giữa người dạy và người học sẽ không còn là giáo dục, mà là kiểm soát.
evidence_examples.anchor_phrase: xác suất

rationale.label: Human, civic and cultural values
rationale.definition: Human flourishing, dignity, empathy, democratic life, civic responsibility or cultural expression warrants the future.
rationale.inclusion: Explicit human/public educational ends beyond operational or economic returns.
rationale.exclusion: Any mention of ethics, critical thinking or national identity without a value-based warrant; concrete privacy or grading rights alone.
rationale.boundary_rule: A public educational ideal is here; a geopolitical, national-development or sovereignty objective is RATION_NATIONAL. Preserve the stated value without inventing a shared ideology.

evidence_examples.source_title: Trường đại học bị lạc hướng trong cuộc chiến với AI?
evidence_examples.source_excerpt: Điều này thể hiện sự thoái thác trách nhiệm của giáo dục đại học với tư cách là một thiết chế phục vụ lợi ích chung của xã hội. Các trường đại học cần vận hành như những không gian nơi các bên liên quan có thể tham gia vào các cuộc tranh luận dựa trên lý lẽ về những thách thức cấp bách nhất của xã hội.
evidence_examples.anchor_phrase: thiết chế phục vụ lợi ích chung

rationale.label: National development and strategic autonomy
rationale.definition: The future is warranted by an explicit collective national-development, competitive-position or sovereignty objective.
rationale.inclusion: National modernisation, strategic technological autonomy, regional/global national standing or explicit collective development ambitions.
rationale.exclusion: Vietnam is merely the location; a public official is the speaker; employer demand alone; individual employability.
rationale.boundary_rule: National location is space, not a rationale. A policy citation is RATION_POLICY only if compliance or authority itself supplies a warrant.

evidence_examples.source_title: Ứng dụng trí tuệ nhân tạo (AI) trong giáo dục-đào tạo
evidence_examples.source_excerpt: h thành các nhóm nghiên cứu mạnh, thúc đẩy những hướng nghiên cứu chiến lược, làm chủ công nghệ nền và phục vụ hiệu quả công cuộc hiện đại hóa Quân đội. Trên phương diện chuyển giao công nghệ, Học viện tăng cường hợp tác với các cơ quan trong và ngoài Quân đội để triển khai các ứng dụng AI vào thực tiễn huấn luyện, chỉ huy, bảo đảm kỹ thuật và hậu cầ
evidence_examples.anchor_phrase: hiện đại hóa

rationale.label: Policy or standards compliance
rationale.definition: Alignment with a named policy, formal standard or official requirement itself warrants the future.
rationale.inclusion: The speaker invokes compliance, obligation or an authoritative mandate as a reason.
rationale.exclusion: Policy appears only as background, identifies the speaker or states a goal without an alignment warrant.
rationale.boundary_rule: Distinguish the content of a policy goal from reliance on its authority. National development is RATION_NATIONAL even when a policy states it.

evidence_examples.source_title: Bộ GDĐT ban hành Khung nội dung thí điểm giáo dục trí tuệ nhân tạo cho học sinh phổ thông
evidence_examples.source_excerpt: Khung nội dung thí điểm giáo dục trí tuệ nhân tạo cho học sinh phổ thông được ban hành nhằm thực hiện Nghị quyết số 57-NQ/TW ngày 22/12/2024 của Bộ Chính trị về đột phá phát triển khoa học, công nghệ, đổi mới sáng tạo và chuyển đổi số quốc gia; Nghị quyết số 71-NQ/TW ngày 22/8/2025 của Bộ Chính trị về đột phá phát triển
evidence_examples.anchor_phrase: được ban hành nhằm thực hiện Nghị quyết

technology_object.label: Generative AI
technology_object.definition: AI is explicitly identified as a generative model/system producing new text, images, audio, video, code or other content.
technology_object.inclusion: Generative AI, language models, generative chat systems or an explicitly content-generating model.
technology_object.exclusion: A tutor or chatbot without a stated generative form; an AI classifier that produces labels rather than new content.
technology_object.boundary_rule: Classify the model/system family, not its educational use or interface. A language model generating grades or feedback remains generative, not also predictive merely because assessment is its use.

evidence_examples.source_title: Nguy cơ dùng AI gian lận thi tốt nghiệp THPT, cách gì ngăn chặn?
evidence_examples.source_excerpt: Theo anh Toàn, hầu hết công cụ AI tạo sinh phổ biến hiện tại đều yêu cầu kết nối internet để hoạt động (như ChatGPT hoặc Gemini - PV ), do đó triển khai các biện pháp kỹ thuật nhằm ngăn chặn truy cập internet ở các khu vực nhạy cảm kết hợp với kiểm tra
evidence_examples.anchor_phrase: công cụ AI tạo sinh

technology_object.label: Predictive or discriminative AI
technology_object.definition: AI is explicitly identified as a non-generative system that classifies, scores, predicts, detects or recognises patterns in supplied data.
technology_object.inclusion: Risk prediction, recognition systems, analytical scoring or authenticity/misconduct detection with an identified analytical capability.
technology_object.exclusion: Generic machine learning with no identified model family/capability; a generative model used to analyse a document.
technology_object.boundary_rule: Detection of cheating and detection of bullying share a technical family but have different educational roles. Do not infer a second object code from different uses of the same model. A hybrid requires explicit evidence of distinct generative and predictive components.

evidence_examples.source_title: Trung Quốc dùng AI ngăn chặn gian lận trong kỳ thi tuyển sinh đại học

evidence_examples.anchor_phrase: mô hình nhận diện hành vi bất thường

technology_object.label: AI form unspecified

technology_object.exclusion: Inferring generative AI from popularity or predictive AI from an interface alone.
technology_object.boundary_rule: Robots, simulations, platforms and computing infrastructure are literal embodiment/deployment details, not competing categories at another level. This fallback marks unspecified technical form and is not evidence of a substantive AI type.

evidence_examples.anchor_phrase: các trường đại học cần

education_context.exclusion: Any education justified by employment; any engineering degree.
education_context.boundary_rule: Use the stated institutional/programme type, not the presence of career preparation.

evidence_examples.source_title: Ứng dụng trí tuệ AI trong phát triển giáo dục nghề nghiệp
evidence_examples.source_excerpt: nhà khoa học , chuyên gia, giảng viên, cơ quan quản lý và doanh nghiệp về ứng dụng trí tuệ nhân tạo trong giảng dạy, quản trị và đánh giá đào tạo nghề, góp phần nâng cao chất lượng nguồn nhân lực quốc gia trong kỷ nguyên số .

education_context.boundary_rule: Current occupational development is here; initial university formation is CTX_HIGHER. If the same course is described as both a degree and professional CPD, retain the explicit dual setting.

education_context.inclusion: Neighbourhood learning, family learning, senior/community courses or informal lifelong learning.
education_context.exclusion: Any learning outside a physical classroom; unlocated self-study by unspecified students.

evidence_examples.source_title: Lớp học AI đặc biệt cho người già thời 4.0 của thầy "bí thư xóm"

evidence_examples.anchor_phrase: dạy lại cho hàng xóm trong khu phố

timespan.label: Immediate / being realised
timespan.definition: The future arrangement is explicitly being implemented or realised at the source’s reference time.
timespan.inclusion: An articulated desired arrangement currently entering implementation.
timespan.exclusion: Routine present AI use without a future arrangement; a past launch alone; soon without current implementation.
timespan.boundary_rule: Current realisation differs from a prospective target, however close. This category does not relax future-eligibility rules.

evidence_examples.source_title: Ứng dụng trí tuệ nhân tạo chăm sóc sức khỏe học sinh

timespan.label: Near-term

timespan.exclusion: A calendar date or number of years interpreted as near without source wording; current implementation; unspecified after graduation.

evidence_examples.source_title: ChatGPT có ảnh hưởng đến việc giảng dạy ngoại ngữ?

evidence_examples.anchor_phrase: tương lai gần

timespan.label: Distant / long-term
timespan.definition: The source explicitly characterises the future as distant or long-term.
timespan.inclusion: Source-stated long-term effects, distant future or effects across future generations.
timespan.exclusion: A number of years alone; continuous/lifelong learning without an endpoint; bare future wording.
timespan.boundary_rule: A ten-year projection retains that exact horizon but is not automatically assigned distant without a stated long-term characterisation.

evidence_examples.source_title: Trường học Ấn Độ có giáo viên đầu tiên bằng AI
evidence_examples.source_excerpt: Mặc dù còn phải theo dõi tác động lâu dài, nhưng Iris chắc chắn sẽ mang đến cái nhìn thoáng qua về tương lai của giáo dục, nơi AI đóng vai trò hỗ trợ trong lớp học.
evidence_examples.anchor_phrase: tác động lâu dài

timespan.label: Ongoing / continuous

timespan.exclusion: An unspecified future; the AI era alone; a bounded multi-year rollout.

evidence_examples.source_title: Tác động của AI đến tương lai của giáo dục
evidence_examples.source_excerpt: ện, giải quyết vấn đề, hợp tác, sáng tạo, hiểu biết về kỹ thuật số, trí tuệ cảm xúc và nhận thức văn hóa. "Điều này thúc đẩy việc học tập suốt đời và chuẩn bị cho học sinh chuyển đổi nghề nghiệp", bà nói thêm.

timespan.label: Explicit horizon; proximity unstated

action.label: Establish coordination or partnerships
action.definition: Actors create a specified joint arrangement for implementing or governing the future.
action.inclusion: A joint programme, agreed coordination mechanism or explicit division of joint tasks.
action.exclusion: Several actors are named; a supplier sells a product; generic calls for cooperation with no specified arrangement.
action.boundary_rule: Code the coordinating arrangement itself. Resource provision adds ACT_RESOURCES only when separately proposed.

action.label: Evaluate the AI intervention
action.definition: Actors produce or use evidence to decide whether an AI-related educational intervention should proceed or change.
action.inclusion: Pilot evaluation, error-rate testing, impact research or review before scaling.
action.exclusion: Grading students; checking an answer while studying; uncertainty without a proposed study.
action.boundary_rule: The evaluated object is the intervention, not learner achievement or an individual output.

evidence_examples.source_title: Ứng dụng trí tuệ nhân tạo ngăn chặn bạo lực học đường
evidence_examples.source_excerpt: ần chứng minh tác dụng trong việc phát hiện sớm các hành vi bạo lực học đường. Tuy nhiên, công nghệ mới này cần thêm thời gian để thử nghiệm và kiểm tra sai số, nhằm tối ưu hoá công nghệ.

responsibility.label: Public authorities
responsibility.definition: A public authority is assigned an intervention or accountability.
responsibility.inclusion: Ministries, government agencies, legislatures or security authorities.
responsibility.exclusion: An official comments but assigns no duty.
responsibility.boundary_rule: A state university’s operational duty belongs to RESP_ED_ORG, not automatically public authority.

evidence_examples.source_title: UNESCO kêu gọi quản lý việc sử dụng trí tuệ nhân tạo trong trường học
evidence_examples.source_excerpt: các công cụ AI có tiềm năng giúp đỡ trẻ em như một trợ lý nghiên cứu, song những công cụ này chỉ trở nên an toàn và hiệu quả nếu các chính phủ quản lý việc sử dụng, đồng thời giáo viên, học sinh và nhà nghiên cứu cùng tham gia vào quá trình thiết kế công cụ.

responsibility.label: Educational organisations
responsibility.definition: An educational institution, its leadership or an organisational unit is assigned an intervention.
responsibility.inclusion: Schools/universities organise, fund, adopt or govern implementation.
responsibility.exclusion: A teacher’s personal instructional action; institutional location alone.
responsibility.boundary_rule: Teachers must redesign lessons -> RESP_ED_WORKER. The school must adopt a policy -> this code.

evidence_examples.source_title: ChatGPT, AI phát triển khiến giảng viên thay đổi cách ra đề thi
evidence_examples.source_excerpt: AI một cách dễ dàng có thể nảy sinh các vấn đề về đạo văn hoặc gian lận trong quá trình học tập của sinh viên. Điều này thúc đẩy các trường đại học cần có những giải pháp phù hợp, đồng thời trang bị cho giảng viên và người học những kiến thức, kỹ năng cần thiết.
evidence_examples.anchor_phrase: các trường đại học cần có những giải pháp

responsibility.label: Education and research workers
responsibility.definition: Teachers, instructors, researchers or educational staff are assigned an intervention in their professional capacity.
responsibility.inclusion: Teaching, assessment, mentoring or research duties.
responsibility.exclusion: A university is assigned a corporate duty without individual staff assignment.
responsibility.boundary_rule: Do not infer all staff duties from an institutional commitment.

responsibility.label: Learners
responsibility.definition: Learners are assigned educational choices, conduct or accountability.
responsibility.inclusion: Verification, responsible use, independent effort or disclosure duties.
responsibility.exclusion: Learners benefit but are assigned no action.
responsibility.boundary_rule: A future learning benefit is not a responsibility.
